p1: Part 1 of 2. New episode: Joseph's Dream (Advent). Make 12 separate wide 16:9 images, same soft 3D style, warm light and same Eliora characters as before, gentle and child-friendly, no text. Setting: the little town of Nazareth with stone houses, a cozy carpenter's workshop with wood shavings and tools, warm lantern light at night. Joseph: a kind, strong young man with short dark hair and a short dark beard in a brown robe with a tan sash and a carpenter's apron. Mary: a gentle young woman with a soft blue head covering over a cream dress. The angel: a radiant kind angel in white with a soft golden glow, shown gently in a dream scene, never scary. Baby Jesus: a sweet sleeping baby wrapped in cream cloths with a soft warm glow. IMPORTANT: porch scenes use Grandpa Sol, Zara, Eli and Pip in exactly their reference-sheet outfits (mustard cardigan and round gold glasses; green dress with yellow ribbons; red-white striped T-shirt and blue shorts; lamb with gold bell on blue ribbon). Story scenes must NOT include Grandpa Sol, Zara, Eli or Pip, and no grey-bearded old man in story scenes. 1) Grandpa Sol's porch with Zara and Eli arranging a little nativity set on a table, Pip sitting beside the donkey figure, Grandpa Sol smiling. 2) Eli holding the Joseph figure and asking a question, Zara and Pip beside him, the nativity set glowing, Grandpa Sol listening. 3) Grandpa Sol, Zara, Eli and Pip cozy together on the porch bench with a blanket, Eli's eyes bright, warm light. 4) The quiet town of Nazareth at sunset, stone houses with glowing windows, a peaceful hill path. 5) Joseph in his carpenter's workshop sanding a wooden bench, wood shavings, tools on the wall, warm light. 6) A close-up of Joseph's strong careful hands working wood, golden sawdust, warm light. 7) Joseph carrying a wooden stool and smiling to a neighbor child in the street, friendly kindness. 8) Joseph and Mary walking together on a quiet path, gentle smiles, golden evening light. 9) Joseph sitting alone at a wooden table at night, a small oil lamp glowing, thoughtful and a little worried. 10) A close-up of Joseph's worried thoughtful face, resting his head on his hand by lamp light. 11) Joseph lying on his bed at night, eyes open, looking at the dark ceiling, moonlight through the window. 12) Joseph asleep peacefully in a small bed with moonlight and a soft golden glow beginning to appear. Create all 12 as separate cartoon images in the same soft 3D style (not realistic).

t: Make one wide 16:9 title image in the same soft 3D style as the story: Grandpa Sol's cozy porch at dusk with soft twinkle lights and a little nativity set on a table, Zara, Eli and Pip smiling and holding a little wooden cradle made of craft sticks while Grandpa Sol smiles. In the foreground, a big carved wooden sign lettered exactly "GOD WITH US" in big clear capital letters, and below it a cream ribbon banner lettered exactly "JOSEPH'S DREAM". No other text, no watermark. Place the sign and ribbon so they do not cover any character's head or face. Use a warm palette of gold, deep red, cream and soft green, with the same reference-sheet outfits as before.
